Maria: OMG :heart_eyes: commander Cosmo. the tail flick when he taxied is everything.
Jen: that stare is pure NASA-level focus. did you use catnip as fuel? :laughing:

Amy: tiny poll: A) take him to the park B) keep him as desk commander. vote with A/B
Kai: results so far: A:3 B:1 — leaning toward a park recon mission :ballot_box_with_ballot:
photo-bot: Auto-tagging: pet, cat, cardboard, spacecraft
Maria: can someone photoshop a tiny helmet on him? i can try tonight :paintbrush:

Amy: A
Kai: ok park mission scheduled tomorrow during lunch. cosmo will be first class :tada: (reaction :heart: from Maria)
Maria: cannot wait to see commander Cosmo explore the shrub nebula 🌿🪐
